chunks: And in it that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except in the deeds that are from them.
So when they perform them, they become from them, and Satan becomes their authority through them.

key_terms.مِنْهُمْ: From them (فِي الْأَعْمَالِ الَّتِي هِيَ مِنْهُمْ)

ai.seo_question: How does Satan gain authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the Shia doctrine of conditional subjugation (*Taqleeb*), where Satan's authority is not inherent but granted through human free will and specific actions. This underscores the believer's agency, as their own deeds serve as the medium through which the devil gains temporary control, reinforcing the necessity of conscious spiritual vigilance.
